tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum sngon 'gro tshul bzhi dang bcas pa'i don 'grel zin bris
༄༅/ /gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum sngon 'gro tshul bzhi dang bcas pa'i don 'grel zin bris

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI146_rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum sngon 'gro tshul bzhi dang bcas pa'i.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum sngon 'gro tshul bzhi dang bcas pa'i don 'grel zin bris rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra ye/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal dges mdzad rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor kun nas yongs rdzogs shing / /brtse ba'i tsha zer 'bum phrag 'phro ba can/ /nus pas gdul bya'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /gang gi bstan pa dus mthar spel ba'i phyir/ /bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i sprul pa'i sku/ /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' rin chen gyi/ /rnam thar dran pas yang yang phyag bgyi 'o/ /de sras grangs med bskal pa'i sngon rol nas/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus thugs chud pa'i/ /skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs mched/ /zhabs zung tshangs pa'i yul sar brtan bzhugs mdzod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams ma lus kun/ /kun gyi spro dang bsdu pa'i byed po gang / /gang zhig he ru ka dpal mus pa rje/ /rje btsun bslu med gang des bdag skyongs shig /zab yangs rgyud sde bye ba'i gsang mdzod don/ /spyi sbas mthar thug 'di zhes 'dom pa la/ /deng sang ljongs 'dir kun gyis 'gran bral ba'i/ /rgyud sde'i nyi ma drin can khyod bsngags 'os/ /de ltar thub pa'i bstan la thub dbang ltar/ /yongs su grags shing grags pa don ldan pa'i/ /shes bya kun gzigs mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen/ /ngag dbang chos grags zhabs la phyag btsal nas/ /de gsung las 'ong gangs can bstan pa'i bdag /sa skya'i yab chos dges rdor rgyud gsum gyi/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i don 'grel rin chen gter/ /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub phyir 'dir spel lo/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'dir gang gtan la dbab par bya ba'i chos ni/

bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bka' babs pa'i kyai rdo rje rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa'i nang nas/ 'dir rgyud gsum 'chad par byed pa la don gnyis te/ tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rgyud kyi spyi don bshad pa dang / gzhung gi 'bru gnyer ba'i sgo nas rgyud dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyud 'grel byung tshul/ de'i brgyud pa rim pa smos pa/ spyi don dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rtsa rgyud la 'grel pa byung tshul/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur la 'grel pa byung tshul/ thun mong pa'i bshad rgyud sam+bu ṭi la 'grel pa byung tshul lo/ /dang po rtsa rgyud la 'phags yul du 'grel pa byung tshul dang / bod yul du 'grel pa byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i rgyud 'grel dkar chag las/ dpal ldan brtag pa gnyis pa yi/ /rgyud kyi tshig don 'grel byed pa/ /rdo rje snying po nā ro pa/ /nag po spyod pa bha wa bha/ /ḍaṃ ka da sha pad+ma dang / /mi thub zla ba shān+ti pa/ /dam tshig rdo rje pad myug dang / /ka mu bhe nu chos grags te/ /'phags yul 'grel byed bcu gcig mthong / /'on kyang chos grags 'grel pa ni/ /bod mar mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bzhed/ /gangs ri'i rdo rjes mdzad pa yi/ /dka' 'grel yod de sngon ma 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa bod yul du byung ba la lnga ste/ snga rabs pa'i 'grel pa byung tshul/ sa chen yab sras rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa byung tshul/ bla chen 'phags pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa byung tshul/ chos rje bla ma rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa byung tshul/ sbyar byang gsal ba med pa'i 'grel ṭīka byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bod na rwa rngog dpyal se sogs/ /bshad pa'i bka' srol mang na yang /

/mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa'i/ /lugs la bla ma mnga' ris pa/ /gsal ba'i snying po'i dka' 'grel dang / /sgyi chu ba yi tshig 'grel yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rwa pa dang rngog pa sogs la rgyud kyi bshad bka' dang / 'grel pa byung yang rang lugs su mi mdzad pas 'dir ma smos la/ rang lugs mdzad pa ni/ ming gsal dngos su mdzad pa de gnyis yin no/ /gnyis pa sa chen yab sras rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa byung tshul ni/ rje btsun sa chen yab sras kyi/ /dka' 'grel nyi 'od dag ldan gsum/ /spyi rnam rgyud kyi mngon rtogs sogs/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i gzhung bdun sogs/ /shākya grags dang khang ston te/ /gong ma'i rjes 'brangs ṭīk+ka gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang sa chen yab sras gsum gyi 'grel pa ni/ gdul bya rab 'bring mtha' gsum gyi dbang du byas gsungs pa yin te/ dag ldan las/ blo gros mchog rnams bdag gi bla chen gyis/ /mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dka' 'grel blang bya zhing / /blo gros 'bring rnams bla ma rin chen gyis/ /mdzad pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer blang bar bya/ /blo gros tha mas kho bos byas pa yi/ /rnam bshad dag ldan 'di ni blang bar bya/ /spros bcas yid ches ston par 'dod rnams kyi/ /gsum gar blangs pas shin tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa 'phags pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa byung tshul ni/ bla chen 'phags pas mdzad pa yi/ /dag ldan sa bcad mchan bu bzhi/ /ye dang gnyan ston gung pa dang / /ston gzhon rdo rje shes rab ste/ /'phags pa'i rjes 'brangs zin bris lnga/ /rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug grags/ /chos kyi seng ge gzhon nu 'bum/ /kun dga' 'od zer bkris dpal/ /rdo rje tshul khrims 'dre ston te/ /'phags pa'i rjes 'brangs ṭīk+ka brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di'i tshig rkang dang po gnyis rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na med kyang bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis kha bskangs pa yin gsungs/

bzhi pa chos rje bla ma rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa byung tshul ni/ chos rje bla ma gnas drug pa/ /'jigs med grags dang bsod nams grags/ /rgyal po dpal dang rgya ston dang / /dkon gzhon kun dga' bkra shis te/ /sna tshogs bsdus pa'i ṭīk+ka brgyad/ /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gzungs kyi dpal/ /grags rgyal blo gros seng ge ste/ /mchan dang dag chung bsres pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sna tshogs bsdus pa'i ṭīk+ka zhes pa 'di rnams cung thugs rtsis chung bar mdzad pa yin gsungs/ lnga pa mdzad byang gsal kha med pa'i 'grel ṭīka byung tshul ni/ gzhan yang 'dis byas med pa yi/ /ṭīk+ka zin bris dka' 'grel sogs/ /snga rabs mkhas pas sbyar ba yi/ /yig cha rab tu mang po mthong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbyar byang med pa'i dka' 'grel zin bris sogs lnga bcu nga grangs tsam rje rdo rje 'chang gis gzigs pa yin gsungs/ de rnams kyi rtsa rgyud la rgya bod du 'grel pa byung tshul bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur la rgya 'grel ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur 'di la/ /lha yi rigs kyi brtul zhugs kyi/ /dka' 'grel de nyid rgyas pa yod/ /in+d+ra bhu ti nag po pa'i/ /dka' 'grel yod med 'gyur khyad yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rdo rje gur la bod 'grel ni/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po'i don bsdus/ sa chen gyi gur gyi chings ngam/ tho bsgrigs su grags pa'i nyung ngu zhig rje btsun rtse mo'i le'u bzhi pa yan gyi 'grel pa/ rje btsun rin po ches bsdus don dang yongs rdzogs kyi ṭīk+ka gur rgyan rnams mdzad do/ /de rnams la rdo rje gur la rgya bod kyi 'grel pa bzhugs tshul bshad zin nas/ gsum pa thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud sam+bu ṭi la rgya 'grel ni/ in+d+ra bhu tis yang dag pa'i lta ba'i dran pa'i snang ba/ a bha ya ka ras man ngag snye ma/

slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba mdzad do/ /bod kyi 'grel pa ni sa chen gyis dka' 'grel nyung ngu / rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa tshan pa gnyis mdzad/ slob dpon rin po ches brtag pa bcu pa yan gyi rgya cher 'grel gnad kyi gsal byed mdzad nas/ rgyud phyi ma la 'grel pa mi mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gnad kyi gsal byed kyi mjug tu 'di'i rnam par bshad pa ni rje bla ma dam pa thugs rje chen po nyid kyis gzhung dum bu gnyis kyi bdag nyid du gnas pa zhig mdzad pas na 'dir ni rnam par bshad par mi bya'o snyam du bsam pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa nyid kyi don tshang pa la dgongs so/ /'di'i rjes 'brangs kyi ṭīk+ka la rje btsun gyi dngos slob dbang phyug dpal gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang / rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa sogs yod cing / 'di la bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa legs cha bsdus pa'i chen po zhig yod kyang rang lugs ma yin no/ /de rnams ni bshad rgyud sam+bu ṭi la rgya bod kyi 'grel pa yod tshul brjod pa ste/ de dag gis ni rgyud gsum gyi 'grel pa byung tshul bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa brgyud pa'i rim pa la/ ring brgyud dang / nye brgyud gnyis las/ dang po ni rje btsun rin po che'i ljon shing las/ rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /rje btsun chos skyong mthu stobs dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ /nag po ḍa ma pa dang a wa dhu ti pa/ /rje btsun gā ya dha ra shākya ye shes mchog /ces pa man ngag lugs kyi brgyud pa dang / gnyis pa/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka dpal de rjes su/ /a la la dang dpal ldan nags khrod gar+bha ri/ /rgyal ba dpal gyi ye shes sbyangs dka' zla ba dang / /dpa' bo rdo rjes ye shes zhabs la gdams pa'o/ /zhes pa ni 'grel pa lugs kyi brgyud pa dang / de bzhin du 'grel pa dag ldan las/

rje btsun mthun stobs nag po ḍa ma pa/ /a wa dhu ti gā ya dha ra dpal/ /gzhan yang gnyis pa ḍom+bhi he ru ka /a la la dang nags khrod gar+bha ri/ /dza ya shrī dang sbyangs dka' mdzes pa'i zhabs/ /rnam gnyis ye shes zhabs las rgyal po'i zhabs/ /snying po rig dang 'bar ba 'bar ba'i zhabs/ /brgyud 'dzin bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar brgyud pa'i bka' srol gnyis kyi bdag po 'brog mi shākya ye shes las slob ma ji ltar 'phel zhing / de dag las brgyud de rje sa skya pa chen pos ji ltar gsan pa'i tshul ni/ yang ljon shing las/ ma dros ye shes zhabs las rgyun bzhi'i bla ma ni/ /rgyal po rig dang snying po snang ba'i mtha' can te/ /rig dang snying po zhabs las 'bar ba 'bar ba'i mtha'/ /rgyun bzhi 'dzin pa'i bla chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'i rjes su rje btsun sku mched sogs kyis ji ltar gsan pa'i tshul/ 'grel pa dag ldan las/ mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma thugs rje can/ /bsod nams mtha' yas rtser gyur tshul khrims mchog /rab grags gtsug tor bde legs kun 'byung ba'i/ /zhabs la phyag 'tshal rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na 'grel pa la ma ltos par rgyud don bla ma'i man ngag gis bshad pa la man ngag lugs dang rgyud rkyang gi bshad pa zhes bya/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i rgyud 'dzin slob dpon sbyangs dka' zla bas 'grel pa ku mu ti mdzad de/ 'grel pa de la brten nas rgyud kyi don bshad pa la 'grel pa lugs zhes bya/ 'grel pa gzhan la brten nas bshad pa rnams kyang spyir 'grel pa lugs yin mod/ gnyis su phye ba'i 'grel pa lugs ni sbyangs dka' zla ba'i 'di kho na la ngos 'dzin/ lugs gnyis kyi khyad par ni 'chad thabs gdams ngag drug dang / mngon par rtogs pa rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas ston pa ni man ngag lugs yin/ 'chad thabs mtha' drug tshul bzhi dang /

'jig rten gyi dpe dang bstun nas mngon par rtogs pa yan lag lnga'i sgo nas ston pa 'grel pa lugs yin te/ de'i rnam gzhag ni 'grel pa ku mu tir gsal/ man ngag lugs kyi khyad chos de rnams ni/ gong ma'i ljon shing rnam bshad nyi 'od/ dag ldan rnams na gsal bar bzhugs te/ de skad du ljon shing las/ rje btsun mthu stobs gsung gi man ngag ni/ /gā ya dha ras gsungs pa 'dir gtso ste/ /ḍom+bhi'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i gsung ngag don/ /sbyangs dka' zla bas gsungs pa gzhan du gsal/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang de yin no/ /'on kyang rnam bshad nyi 'od dang / dag ldan rnams gtso cher man ngag lugs yin zhing / 'grel pa lugs kyang sib tshegs rnams la cung zad smos pa mang du yod cing / 'grel pa lugs la yang bir+wa pa nas brgyud pa'i 'chad thabs gdams ngag drug dang / mngon par rtogs pa rgyud gsum gyis bcings pa med pa ma yin la/ gtso bor 'chad thabs mtha' drug tshul bzhi dang / mngon par rtogs pa yan lag lnga'i chings kyis ston pa yin no/ /mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing ni rtsa bshad phyogs re ba'i don ston pa ma yin par/ kyai rdor rgyud gsum gyi brjod don phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi rim pa brjod bya don gyi rgyud gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa'i rims pa dang sbyar nas bshad pa yin pas rgyud gsum gcig tu bsres pa'i bshad pa zhes kyang bya/ stong thun nam spyi don gyi sgo nas rtsa bshad kyi rgyud gsum ka'i bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhig yin te/ ljon shing nyid las/ rje btsun 'brog mi shākya ye shes las brgyud pa'i he badz+ra rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud gsum gcig tu bsres pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i yi ge zhes dang / rgyud gsum po gcig tu bsres pa'i sa gzhir yid kyi sa bon btab ste/ bla ma'i gsung las byung ba'i mngon par rtogs pa'i ljon shing zhes gsungs pas so/

/de rnams kyis ring brgyud kyi rnam gzhag bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa nye brgyud ni/ rje btsun rin po ches rgyud kyi spyi don nam/ stong thun sa bcad du grags pa'i mjug tu/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bgo de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs/ /blo ldan don 'di shes na smra bar byos/ /legs 'ongs mig gis yon tan gsal bar byas/ /me dang chu bos 'byung ba rab tu bskyed/ /zla bas kun kyang gsal bar byed mod kyi/ /mig gis legs par bltas pas bdag blo dad/ /gzugs gnyis yon tan zung ni thog ma ste/ /gang gis gang ston lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ /gzhung 'dir legs par bltas pas blo ldan gyis/ /legs rtogs gzhan la ston na bdag blo spro/ /legs 'ongs 'chad pa bshad gzhi lo rgyus bcas/ /rnam 'grel bcas pas sdig 'joms gzhan mi ldan/ /mkha' mtshungs 'dzin bcas dri ma kun spangs te/ /yi ge bzhi ldan nyid du 'gyur bar shog /ces gsungs pa ltar yin te/ 'di'i don 'chad pa la/ bla med spyi'i nye brgyud/ bye brag dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi nye brgyud/ zhar la rgyud gsum 'chad tshul/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bla med ces pa ni bla med kyi rgyud sde/ phyogs ni bcu/ ri ni bdun te bcu bdun gyis bsgyur pas bdun cu/ de'i steng du mig ste gnyis bsnan pas bla med kyi rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ rig byed de tshul bzhi'i sgo nas gsal bar rdo rje 'chang gis lag pa'i brdas mtshon pa'i brgyud pa gnyis pa bir+wa pa la gnang / des me ste brgyud pa gsum pa sa skya pa chen po la gnang / des chu gter te brgyud pa bzhi pa slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo la gnang / des 'byung ba ste brgyud pa lnga pa rje btsun rin po che la gnang ba yin pas/ blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis brda 'di'i don shes pa'am/

go na smra bar byos zhes ston pa la bla med ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig byung / gnyis pa bye brag kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas legs par brgyud de 'ongs pa'i mig bir+wa pas/ yon tan te dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gsal bar byas pa de nyid gong gi me sa skya pa chen po dang / chu bo rje btsun rtse mo/ 'byung ba rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi blos rab tu bskyed ces ston pa la/ legs 'ongs mig gi zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis byung / des na zla ba'i brdas mtshon pa'i brgyud pa dang po rdo rje 'chang gi brgyud nas ring brgyud kun kyang gsal bar byed mod kyi 'dir ni mig rje btsun bir+wa pas sa skya pa chen po la mngon sum du legs par bltas pas/ nye brgyud kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar 'di la bdag gi blo shin tu dad ces ston pa la/ legs 'ongs zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis byung / gsum pa zhar la rgyud gsum 'chad pa'i tshul ni/ gzugs ni gcig la 'jug pas de gnyis ni tshul dang po gnyis/ yon tan ni gsum la 'jug cing / zung ni gnyis la 'jug pas gsum gnyis drug ni tshul gsum pa rgyud 'chad thabs kyi gdams ngag drug thog ma ni sngon du btang nas/ rgyud gang gis mngon par rtogs pa gang ston/ lo rgyus brgyud pa'i rim pa dang bcas pa rgyud gsum gyi gzhung 'dir legs par bltas pas blo dang ldan pas legs par rtogs par 'gyur ba'i gdul bya gzhan la ston na bdag gi blo spro zhes ston pa la gzugs gnyis yon tan zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig byung / des na legs 'ongs 'chad pa slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi rnam dang / bshad gzhi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas ston pa rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs ljon shing / rgyud dngos 'chad pa la rnam 'grel so so bsdus don dang bcas pas ma dag pa sdig pa'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa ni gzhan dang 'dra bar ldan pa ma yin te/

gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas so zhes ston pa la legs 'ongs 'chad pa zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis byung / bzhi pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ de ltar brda tshig gi sgo nas nye brgyud kyi rnam par smos pa'i dge ba des/ sems can thams cad nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i chos kyi sku brnyes shing spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma kun spangs te/ thob bya shrī he ru ka nyid du 'gyur bar shog cig ces bsngo ba ston pa la/ mkha' mtshungs zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis po de byung ba yin no/ /de dag gis ni brgyud pa'i rim pa bstan zin nas/ gsum pa spyi don dngos bshad pa ni/ rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ rnam gzhag mtshan gyi don dang bshad thabs dang / /mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya tshul bzhi yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag rgyud kyi mtshan don/ rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag rgyud kyi lam rim mngon par rtogs pa dang bzhi las/ dang po rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag la yang bzhi ste/ sngags kyi theg pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ pha rol tu phyin pa las rdo rje theg pa khyad par du 'phags tshul/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyud sde'i dbye ba/ rgyud sde'i 'byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sngags kyi theg pa/ gzhi mi spong ba'i theg pa/ 'bras bu'i theg pa/ rdo rje'i theg pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs yin no/ /gnyis pa pha rol tu phyin pa las sngags kyi theg pa khyad par du 'phags tshul ni/ slob dpon kṛ pi ta ka mas tshul gsum sgron mar/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtogs par bya'o/ /gsum pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyud sde'i dbye ba la gnyis te/ spyir rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba/ bla med kyi rgyud bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ bzhir dbye ba'i 'thad pa/

grangs dang go rim nges pa/ ming don bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi rol mu stegs byed la 'dod chags can dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brangs pa chags pa chos su smra ba dang / zhe sdang can khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'brangs pa 'tshe ba chos su smra ba dang / gti mug can tshangs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa gti mug chos su smra ba dang / gsum ka'i rjes su 'brangs pa gsum ga chos su smra ba ste log par spyod pa bzhi yod pa de rnams rjes su bzung ba'i don du rgyud sde bzhi gsungs par sngon gyi slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs dang / kun dga' snying po la sogs pa rnams bzhed/ ces grag go /yang rang sde nang pa sangs rgyas pa la yang brjod du med pa'i gang zag gi bdag khas len pa dang / rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med dang / shes pa skad cig cha med bden par 'dod pa dang / gzung ba bden par med kyang 'dzin pa bden par 'dod pa dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis ka bden par mi 'dod pa dang lugs bzhi yod pa'i de dag dang sgo bstun nas rgyud sde bzhi'i bskyed chog gsungs pa yin par slob dpon klu sgrub la sogs pa bzhed ces bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gsungs so/ /zhes slob dpon rtse mos bshad pa la bu ston rin po ches lung khungs btsal dgos so zhes gsungs mod kyang / lung kha gsal med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos/ slob dpon de rnams de ltar bzhed cing grag go zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ bu ston rin po ches 'di ni shin tu mi 'thad pa yin zhes gsungs so/ /rang lugs ni 'dod pa khams pa la pho mo phan tshun blta ba dang / rgod pa la sogs pa chags rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pas de rnams lam du bsgyur nas byang chub sgrub par byed pas rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rgod dang blta ba dag gi dang / /'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis kyi/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyi/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yo ga ba shākya bshes gnyen ni/ bla med kyi rgyud kyang yo gar bsdus nas rgyud sde gsum du bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la grangs dang go rim nges pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gdul bya dman pa la bya rgyud/ 'bring la spyod rgyud/ mchog la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ ches mchog tu gyur pa la bla med kyi rgyud gsungs par bshad pas/ rgyud sde bzhir grangs dang go rim nges pa yin te/ gdul bya 'dul bar byed pa la rgyud sde bzhi las grangs mang mi dgos shing / nyung na mi 'du ba'i phyir dang / go rim yang dman mchog gi go rim yin par lung de nyid kyis 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ming don ni/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa gtso bor ston pas bya rgyud dang / de dang nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam du ston pas spyod rgyud/ ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ ting nge 'dzin bla na med pa'am/ gong na med pa gtso bor ston pas bla med kyi rgyud ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bla med kyi rgyud bshad pa la gsum ste/ ma rgyud sogs gsum du dbye ba/ rtsa bshad gnyis su dbye ba/ mdo rgyas dang bzhugs tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bla med kyi rgyud la dbye na/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med rgyud dang gsum du yod do/ /'di gsum gyi khyad par la/ gleng gzhi'i yi ge'i khyad par/ bskyed rim gyi lha'i khyad par/ rdzogs rim gyi nyams len gyi khyad par/ rjes spyod rnam dag gi khyad par/ zhu ba po gdul bya'i khyad par dang lnga las/ dang po gleng gzhi yi ge'i khyad par ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa la sogs pas dbu drangs nas gleng gzhi yod pa ni pha rgyud/ gsang ba mchog gis dgyes pa na/ /zhes sogs kyis dbu drangs nas gleng gzhi yod pa ni ma rgyud/ gnyis ka tshang ba ni gnyis med rgyud yin te/

kyai rdo rje'i rgyud lta bu la mtshon na/ rtsa rgyud la dang po tshang / rdo rje gur la gnyis pa tshang / sam+bu ṭi la gnyis ka tshang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa bskyed rim gyi lha'i khyad par ni/ lha yab kyis gtso bo byas shing / 'khor gyi lha grangs pho mang ba ni pha rgyud/ lha yum gyis gtso bo byas shing / 'khor gyi lha grangs mo mang ba ni ma rgyud/ gnyis ka tshang ba ni gnyis med rgyud yin no/ /gsum pa rdzogs rim nyams len gyi khyad par ni/ rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa phra thig la sogs pa thabs kyi nyams len gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la sogs pa shes rab kyi nyams len gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud/ gnyis ka cha mnyam du ston pa gnyis med rgyud yin no/ /bzhi pa rjes spyod rnam dag gi khyad par ni/ rags pa phung khams skye mched kyi rnam dag yod pa ni pha rgyud/ phra ba rtsa thig gi rnam dag yod pa ni ma rgyud/ gnyis ka tshang ba ni gnyis med rgyud yin te/ kyai rdo rje rgyud lta bu la/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes sogs ni dang po/ rtsa ni gnyis gnyis rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes sogs ni gnyis pa yin pas gnyis ka tshang ba yin no/ /lnga pa zhu ba po gdul bya'i khyad par ni/ zhu ba po skyes pas gtso bor zhus pa ni pha rgyud/ bud med kyis gtso bor zhus pa ni ma rgyud/ gnyis ka tshang ba ni gnyis med rgyud yin te/ kyai rdo rje rtsa rgyud brtag pa dang po ni/ rdo rje snying pos gtso bor zhus/ brtag pa phyi ma ni bdag med mas gtso bor zhus pa yin pas rtsa rgyud 'di la gnyis ka tshang ba'i phyir/ de skad du yang rdo rje gur las/ kyai rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rgyud/ /dang po rgyal ba rnams kyis bshad/ /phyi ma rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /de nyid bud med bzung phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na thabs shes gnyis kyi nang nas thabs gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud/ shes rab gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud/

gnyis ka cha mnyam du ston pa gnyis med rgyud yin te/ de skad du 'bum phrag lnga pa'i lung rdo rje snying 'grel du drangs pa las/ thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pas/ /kyai rdo rje phyogs gcig min/ /don gyi 'dus pa la sogs pa/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid do/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las kyang / thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/ /de ni nga yi bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /yang bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis rtsa rgyud brtag pa dang po pha rgyud/ brtag pa phyi ma ma rgyud/ gnyis ka sdom pa gnyis med rgyud yin zhes gsungs kyang / 'di ni shin tu mi 'thad par snang gsungs/ gnyis pa rtsa bshad gnyis su dbye ba ni/ rgyud gang zhig sngon la byung ba bshad gzhir gyur pa ni rtsa rgyud dang / rgyud gang zhig rjes la byung ba 'chad byed du gyur pa ni bshad rgyud du 'jog pa yin la/ rtsa rgyud la dbye na rgyas pa dang / brtag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'bum lngar grags pa sh+lau ka 'bum phrag lnga/ brtag pa sum cu so gnyis/ le'u stong phrag sum cu yod pa'i rgyud de nyid yin zhing / rtsa rgyud bsdus pa ni sh+lau ka bdun brgya dang lnga bcu/ brtag pa gnyis/ le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum yod pa'i rgyud 'di nyid yin no/ /'di nyid dpal nā ro pas 'bum phrag lnga pa'i brtag pa dang po gnyis logs su phyung ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang / yang pham thing pa chen pos rgyud gang nas kyang phyung ba ma yin rang skya thub pa'i rgyud yin zhes gsungs pa ni rang lugs 'dir khas mi len te/ rgyud 'di nyid las/ gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par/ /rgyas par gsungs pa mdo ru bsdu/ /zhes pas dngos su gnod pa'i phyir dang / brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis las phyung ba zhes pa dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir/ des na rang lugs rtsa rgyud 'di ni 'bum phrag lnga pa'i brtag pa phyi ma gnyis su logs su phyung ba yin par bzhed de/ tshul gsum mdzes rgyan las/

'bum lnga'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa phyi ma gnyis/ /logs su phyung ba 'jig bral yab sras bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga pa 'di la brtag pa sum cu so gnyis yod pa'i/ brtag pa rnams kyi mtshan dang go rim ni/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u bzhi pa las/ rdo rje snying po mngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po nyid/ /sgyu ma brtag pa gnyis pa ste/ /rdo rje gar ni gsum pa 'o/ /bzhi pa sna tshogs brtag pa zhes/ /rdo rje'i brtag pa lnga pa 'o/ /brtag pa drug pa stobs po che/ /brtag pa bdun pa mi g.yo mgon/ /brgyad pa gzungs kyi brtag pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ku ru kul+le dgu/ /bcu pa 'dul ba'i brtag pa ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcu gcig pa/ /dngos grub brtag pa bcu gnyis pa/ /sgrol ma'i brtag pa bcu gsum pa/ /rdo rje phag mo bcu bzhi pa/ /bco lnga pa ni gzi brjid de/ /bdag med brtag pa bcu drug pa/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bcu bdun pa/ /hūm̐ mdzad la ni bco brgyad pa/ /dbyangs can gyi ni bcu dgu pa/ /sbyin sreg brtag pa nyi shu pa/ /rab gnas nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i brtag pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa ni gnyis su brjod/ /gtor ma'i brtag pa nyi shu gsum/ /nyi shu bzhi pa sta gon gnas/ /mngon par rtogs pa nyi shu lnga/ /de bzhin phyag rgya nyi shu drug /byed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ /glu ni nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug brtag pa ni/ /sum cu gcig med sum cu pa/ /brtag pa sum cu bar ni bshad/ /stong phrag sum cu'i grangs kyi ni/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /'bum phrag lnga yi rgya mtsho che/ /kyai rdo rje rdor 'chang gi /rgyud ni e ma rgyas bstan pa/ /'bum phrag lnga bdag kyai rdo rje'i/ /dag pa'i snying po yongs bzung ba/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros gsungs pa ste/ /'di ni rgyud kyi nges pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/

/yang 'di la rtsa rgyud las/ gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par/ /zhes ku ru kul+le'i brtag pa bcu gnyis par bshad pa dang / gur las/ mkha' 'gro ku ru kul+le dgu/ zhes brtag pa dgu la ku ru kul+le'i brtag par bshad pa dang / dngos grub brtag pa bcu gcig pa/ /zhes brtag pa bcu gcig pa dngos grub kyi brtag par bshad pa rnams 'gal ba ltar snang bas 'di ni dogs pa'i gnas yin zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa bshad rgyud la/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ rdo rje'i gur sh+lau ka stong phrag gcig dang nyer lnga/ le'u bco lnga yod pa'i rgyud 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis kyai rdo rje'i rgyud rgyas bsdus gnyis kho na gsal bar byed pa'i phyir/ thun mong ba ni yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud du grags pa sh+lau ka nyis stong dang brgyad brgya phyed dang bzhi/ brtag pa bcu/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa drug gsal bar byed ces rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /da lta bod du 'gyur ba'i rgyud gzhan la dngos su phan 'dogs pa ni bcu bdun tsam yod de/ tshul gsum mdzes rgyan las/ da lta dngos su gzhan la phan 'dogs pa/ /brtag gnyis gur dang mnyam sbyor sgyu dra dang / /rdo rje gdan bzhi man+d+ra am̐ pa dang / /dgongs lung ma gtogs 'dus pa'i rgyud chen bzhi/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rtsa bshad rnam pa lnga/ /de nyid 'dus pa rdo rje rtse mo ste/ /zab don gces pa bsdus pa bcu bdun yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang 'jigs byed rtog bdun/ sgrol ma rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i las tshogs rab 'byams ston pa'i rgyud rnams kyang rgyud 'dis gsal bar byed pa yin no/ /gzhan yang kyai rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum phrag bdun pa ni rtog pa'i rgyud dang / 'bum lnga las 'phros pa thig le skor lnga/ ra li skor gsum la sogs pa ni rgyud phyi mar bshad pa yin no/

/gsum pa la mdo rgyas dang bzhugs tshul bstan pa ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi gleng gzhis mdor bstan/ brtag pa dang pos rgyas par bshad/ brtag pa phyi mas shin tu rgyas par bshad cing / rdo rje gur gyi le'u dang pos mdor bstan/ le'u lhag ma bcu bzhis rgyas par bshad cing / sam+bu ṭi'i gleng gzhis mdor bstan/ mtshan don gyis cung zad rgyas par bshad/ brtag pa dang pos rgyas par bshad/ brtag pa phyi ma dgus shin tu rgyas par bshad/ rgyud phyi mas tshig don rnam par phye ste bshad pa yin no/ /bzhugs tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud las dang por 'bras rgyud bstan/ de nas thabs rgyud bstan/ de nas rgyu rgyud bstan pa yin zhing / 'di ni gang zag gzhug pa'i go rim yin te/ dang por 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed nas/ de nas lam la slob pa yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje gur las/ go rim nges pa med pa brjod don dkrugs te bstan pa ni/ rtog ge pa rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i ched du yin la/ sam+bu ṭi las/ dang por rgyu rgyud/ de nas thabs rgyud/ de nas 'bras rgyud bstan te/ 'di ni rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim yin no/ /bzhi pa rgyud sde'i byung tshul ni tshul gsum mdzes rgyan las/ skyon med bka' dang bstan bcos dgongs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /o ṭi ya na'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /legs par bcug nas yongs su smin par mdzad/ /de tshe phyag na rdo rjes rgyud kun bsdus/ /nges pa'i don du 'khor dang bsdu pa po/ /tha dad med kyang dman la de ltar snang / /slar yang gsang pa'i bdag pos rgyud sde kun/ /gnas der rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la byin/ /de nas 'jigs chags dbang gis yul phyogs der/ /rgya mtshor gyur pa'i klu rnams smin mdzad de/ /rgyud kun yi ger bris nas glegs bam rnams/ /lag 'gro'i tshogs la byin nas rgyas par mdzad/ /de rjes klu las gyur pa'i dpa' bo dang /

/mkha' 'gro rnams las bi su kap+la sogs/ /grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis legs blangs te/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang / /skyes mchog rnams kyis yongs su dar bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de rnams kyis tshul dang po rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa bstan zin nas/ da ni tshul gnyis pa rgyud kyi mtshan don bshad pa ni/ sems can gyi don la dges pa'i snying rje 'bras dus kyi ye shes su gyur pa ni he/ dmigs med kyi shes rab 'bras dus kyi ye shes su gyur pa badz+ra/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa ni 'bras rgyud dang kyai rdor mtshan nyid pa yin te/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des mtshon nas shugs la sems can gyi rgyud kyi gsal stong zung 'jug ni rgyu rgyud kyi kye rdor dang / rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud kyi bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ni thabs rgyud kyi kyai rdo rje yin la/ rgyud gsum po de dag brjod byar ston pa'i kyai rdo rje'i rgyud tshig ni gzhung kyai rdo rje ste/ de ltar bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid pa dang / phyi ma gsum btags pa ba yin te/ rje btsun sku mched gnyis char gyis kyai rdo rje de gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni kyai rdo rje/ /bsgrub bya de don ldan pa yi/ /gzhung lam dag la'ang de sgra yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dang mthun par yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud ces pas kyang / 'bras rgyud dngos su bstan nas/ gzhan gnyis shugs la bstan pa yin zhing / de bzhin du 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan don yang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos las ring du 'phags pas na 'phags pa/ chos sku nam mkha' dang mnyam du 'gro zhing / gzugs sku rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas nam mkha' la 'gro bas na mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje ni dmigs med kyi shes rab/

gar ni dra ba'i 'grel pa ste phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes/ rgyun chags pas na rgyud/ rtog pas brtags pas don brtag pa zhes bya ste/ 'dis ni 'bras rgyud dang thabs rgyud dngos su bstan nas rgyu rgyud shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /de gsum ka la rgyal po zhes kyang bya ste/ rgyu rgyud kyis rang bzhin gyi mtshan rtog spong ba dang / thabs rgyud kyis glo bur gyi mtshan rtog spong bar byed/ 'bras rgyud ni glo bur gyi mtshan rtog ma lus pa spangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyis rgyud kyi mtshan don bstan zin nas/ gsum pa rgyud 'chad thabs kyi man ngag ni/ tshul gsum mdzes rgyan las/ bshad bya spyi dang sbas pa mthar thug gsum/ /'chad byed yan lag yi ge man ngag gi /gsal bar byed 'di gdams ngag rnam drug ces/ /bshad thabs kun gyi nang nas rgyal po nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bshad bya spyi don du bshad pa/ sbas don du bshad pa/ mthar thug tu bshad pa/ 'chad byed yan lag gi don gyi bshad pa/ yi ge'i don gyi bshad pa/ man ngag gi bshad pa ste drug yod pa las/ dang po spyi la gnyis te/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa spyi dang / bskyed rim spyi'o/ /de yang spyi zhes bya ba ni thun mong ba ste/ dang po pha rol tu phyin pa spyi ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa nas bshad pa'i phar phyin drug byang phyogs so bdun/ lam lnga/ sa bcu/ sku gsum la sogs pa rnams yin te/ de rnams pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rdo rje theg pa gnyis ka'i thun mong ba'i chos yin pas so/ /gnyis pa bskyed rim spyi ni bum dbang gi lam bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa rnams yin te/ de rnams mchog dang / thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis ka bsgrub pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbas don du bshad pa la yang / rang byin rlabs kyi sbas pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i sbas pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gsang dbang gi lam yan lag dang bcas pa rnams kyang sbas pa yin te/

de dag bum dbang tsam thob pa man chad la sbas shing ma grags pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi lam yan lag dang bcas pa rnams yin la/ des mtshon nas dbang bzhi pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa rnams kyang sbas pa yin te/ de dag gsang dbang tsam thob pa man chad la sbas shing ma grags pas so/ /gsum pa mthar thug tu bshad pa la/ spyi'i mthar thug dang / sbas pa'i mthar thug gnyis las/ dang po ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rdo rje theg pa gnyis thun mong ba'i 'bras bur bshad pa'i bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa de yin te/ de mthar thug gi 'bras bu dngos ma yin yang / de dang nye ba'i cha nas des ming gis btags pa yin pas so/ /de skad du sam+bu ṭi las/ gang dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas sngon du ma byas pa ni bde bar gshegs pa ste sangs rgyas yin la zhes gsungs pa yin la/ gnyis pa sbas pa'i mthar thug ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam la brten nas thob pa'i bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa de nyid yin te/ 'di ni sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan zhing / sangs rgyas rang snang gi shes bya thams cad mkhyen tshul sogs pha rol tu phyin pa las khyad par du 'phags pas so/ /de skad du sam+bu ṭi las/ mtshan gzhi mtshon pa ni rdo rje theg pa yang dag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'chad byed yan lag gi don gyi bshad pa ni/ gzhung rtogs dka' ba rnams tshig 'byed bsdu dang / byed tshig rnam dbye la sogs pas so sor phye ste/ seng ge'i lta stangs kyis khyad par gyi gzhi blangs/ sbal pa'i 'phar gyis skabs don so sor phye/ rus sbal 'gros kyis tshig don ma lus pa bshad/ stag mo'i mchongs stabs dang 'dra bas brgal lan mtha' dpyad pa dang bzhis 'chad par byed pa yin zhing / yi ge'i don gyi bshad pa ni/ yan lag gi don gyis rtogs mi nus pa na dang ga ha zhes pa'i na'i sgra las drangs te/ na ra mi dang / ga zhes pa'i sgra las drangs te/

ga wi ba glang dang / ha'i sgra las drangs te ha sti glang po che la bshad pa lta bu sgra drangs te bshad pa dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ston pa'i hūm̐ lta bu yi ge kha phral te bshad pa dang / e wam̐ ma ya bzhi la 'khor lo bzhi dngos su bshad pa med kyang dbyibs mthun pas yi ge dbyibs mthun gyi bshad pa dang gsum yod pa yin la/ 'chad byed man ngag gi bshad pa ni/ yan lag gi don dang yig don gyis mi rtogs pa'i/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /zhes sogs dang / ma da na chang / ba la sha zhes sogs/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi brda mdzad pa'i man ngag gis 'chad dgos pa rnams yin no/ /des na tshul gsum mdzes rgyan las/ mdor na bshad bya'i dbye ba lnga'am drug /'chad byed gsum gyis phye bas 'chad tshul gyis/ /man ngag bco lnga bco brgyad gang 'dod 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar mdor bsdu na/ bshad bya spyi don gcig sbas don gnyis/ mthar thug gi don gnyis te/ bshad bya lnga la 'chad byed gsum gsum sbyar bas 'chad thabs kyi man ngag bco lnga 'byung ba'am/ yang na bshad bya spyi don la gnyis su phye bas bshad bya drug la 'chad byed gsum gsum du phye bas 'chad thabs kyi man ngag bco brgyad 'byung ba yin la/ bshad bya spyi sbas mthar thug gsum po so sor ston pa'i rgyud tshig de dang de 'chad byed yan lag gi don sogs skabs su gang babs de dang de'i 'chad pa ni khre'ur bshad pa dang / thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/ /ces pa lta bu rgyu rgyud thabs rgyud 'bras rgyud gsum dang sbyar nas bshad pa dang / lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /zhes sogs lta bu/ rang bzhin lhan skyes dang zhu bde lhan skyes gnyis dang sbyar nas 'chad pa ni ldan par bshad pa dang / rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang yab kyi rtsa sngags dang rigs su skyes dang la sogs pa la/ bshad bya spyi don/ sbas don gnyis/ mthar thug ste bzhi dang sbyar te bshad pa mi 'dra ba bzhi byed pa ni/

rgyud don yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar bshad pa yin zhing / de dag kyang bshad thabs gdams ngag drug po de dag gi nang sel sib tshegs su tshang ba yin no/ /gzhan yang sems kyi rgyud rgyun chags gcig gtan la dbab pa'i phyir rgyud gsum dang sbyar te bshad pa/ dbang bzhi lam du bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid can gsum dang sbyar te bshad pa/ sku bzhi lam du bya ba'i phyir gnas pa bzhi dang sbyar te bshad pa/ sgrib pa spong ba'i phyir dag pa gsum dang sbyar te bshad pa dang / snod dang mi ldan pa la gab cing gsang ba'i phyir sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud phyi ma nas bshad pa ltar gsang ba bdun gyi bshad pa/ man ngag lugs kyi 'chad thabs lnga po de dag kyang gong gi 'chad thabs dang po gdams ngag drug gi nang du 'dus pa yin no/ /de ltar drug las/ dang po ni/ dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa yin te/ yi ge dang ni yan lag dang / /bsdus pa'i don dang spyi yi don/ /sbas dang de bzhin mthar thug pa/ /man ngag rnam pa drug gi ni/ /rgyud rnams nges pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /yang skar rgyal zla ba'i rgyud 'chad thabs mtha' drug tshul bzhi po rnams kyang 'chad thabs gdams ngag drug po de la tshang ba yin te/ 'chad byed yan lag gi don gyi bshad bya spyi sbas mthar thug gsum 'chad pa ni/ rim pa bzhin sgra ji bzhin pa dang / nges pa'i don dang / dgongs pa can ma yin pa'i bshad pa yin zhing / 'chad byed yi ge'i don dang man ngag gi don gnyis kyis bshad bya spyi sbas mthar thug gsum 'chad pa ni/ rim pa bzhin sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa dang / drang ba'i don dang / dgongs pa can gyi bshad pa yin pas drug po de dag kyang tshang la/ tshul bzhi ni 'chad byed yi ge'i don dang / bshad bya spyi sbas mthar thug bzhi po yin pas/ de dag ni 'chad thabs gdams ngag drug po 'di la dngos su tshang ba yin zhing / gzhan yang gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs pa rnams bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang sbyar te rgyud sgrub thabs ltar bshad pa dang /

gsang 'dus 'phags lugs pa rnams gleng slong ba lnga la sogs pa rgyan bdun gyi sgo nas bshad pa la sogs pa rnams kyang 'chad thabs gdams ngag drug po 'di la ma lus pa tshang ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i sgo nas rgyud 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir bshad pa la tshogs slob kyi bshad pa gnyis su yod par yang gsungs te/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i rgyud sde spyi rnam las/ 'o na bshad pa gnyis gang yin na/ spyi don gnyis su 'chad lugs kyi man ngag gsum gyis rgyud mtha' dag 'chad pa ni tshogs pa la bshad pa yin la/ slob ma slob dpon du gyur pa zab cing rgya che ba'i blo dang ldan pa la bshad pa mtha' dag byed ces gsungs pa yin pas/ des na kye rdor gyi rgyud 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir bum dbang bskyed rim dang bcas pa bshad pa ni tshogs bshad dang / dbang gong ma rdzogs rim dang bcas pa bshad pa ni slob bshad yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de rnams ni tshul gsum pa rgyud 'chad thabs kyi man ngag ste/ de dag gis tshul dang po gsum bstan zin to/ /da ni gsum pa rgyud kyi lam rim mngon par rtogs pa 'chad pa la gnyis te/ rnam grangs kyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ so so'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos pa bzhi/ /skyabs 'gro gso sbyong gtan khrims sems bskyed bzhi/ /bye mdo rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma bzhi/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med bzhi/ /bzhi bzhi bcu drug rgyud dang rim 'jug lam/ /de rjes sngags lam thog ma smin byed dbang / /lam la rtogs pa'i lta ba bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ /spyod dang nye rgyu mchog gi mngon rtogs lnga/ /bzlas dang gtor ma sbyin sreg rab gnas dang / /las tshogs rab 'byams zhes bya yan lag lnga/ /gnyis ka'i thun mong dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /thabs rgyud mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig go

/gnas skabs 'bras bu slob lam sa bcu gnyis/ /mthar thug gnas yongs gyur dang ye shes sku/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das dang gnyis su med/ /mdzad pa rgyun ma chad dang rnam lnga 'o/ /de ltar mngon rtogs bzhi bcu rtsa lnga las/ /gtan khrims bdun dang dbang gi mngon rtogs bdun/ /so sor phye bas lnga bcu bdun du 'gyur/ /de tshe bzhi dang bcu dang bzhi dang bzhi/ /de bzhin bdun dang lnga dang lnga dang gcig /bcu gnyis lnga ste lnga bcu rtsa bdun ni/ /bshad bya mngon par rtogs pa'i lus yin no/ /zhes gsungs ltar yin la/ gnyis pa so so'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa la/ rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gar+bha ri pas/ rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos/ /gang zag rnam pa bzhir ni 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu la ltos pa/ rigs la ltos pa/ spang bya la ltos pa/ rkyen la ltos pa dang bzhi las/ dang po rgyu la ltos pa ni/ sems can thams cad rgyu bde gshegs snying po dang ldan pa 'di nyid yin no/ /rtsa rgyud las rang dang rang gi rtogs pa las/ /sangs rgyas ma yin sems can ni/ /gcig kyang yod pa ma yin no/ /dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang / /lha dang lha min mi rnams dang / /bshang ba'i srin bu la sogs pa/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyis kyang / /bde ba gang phyir mi shes pa/ /rtag tu rang bzhin bde ba can/ /'jig rten khams ni gang du yang / /sangs rgyas gzhan du rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med/ /ces dang / theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma las/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa rigs la ltos pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa gang gi srin lag gi rtsa ba la rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang / nor bu mig gsum pa la sogs pa'i dbyibs kyi ri mo yod pa dang /

rnal 'byor pa gang zhig kha dog nag po shas che ba la sogs pa ni mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i rigs yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ gang gi srin lag rtsa ba la/ /rdo rje rtse dgu par gyur pa/ /mi bskyod pa yi rigs mchog nyid/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi 'khor los 'gyur/ /dpag med mgon gyi 'dam skyes nyid/ /rin chen 'byung gi rin chen nyid/ /las kyi rigs kyi ral gri nyid/ /ces dang / rnal 'byor pa gang nag po che/ /de yi lha ni mi bskyod pa/ /rnal 'byor pa gang ser po che/ /de yi lha ni rnam snang mdzad/ /rnal 'byor pa gang sngo sang che/ /de yi lha ni don yod nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa gang ser po che/ /rin chen bdag po rigs kyi lha/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar dmar nyid/ /'od dpag med pa rigs kyi lha/ /rnal 'byor pa gang dkar dang ser/ /de ni sems dpa'i rigs su 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa spang bya la ltos pa ni/ sbyang gzhi zhe sdang shas che ba ni mi bskyod pa'i rigs dang / gti mug shas che ba sogs ni rnam snang gi rigs la sogs pa yin zhing / bzhi pa rkyen la ltos pa ni/ mtshams med lnga byas pa yang rkyen smin grol gyi lam zab mo nyams su blangs na grol bar 'gyur te/ rtsa rgyud las/ mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / /srog chags gsod la dga' ba dang / /gzhan yang skye ba dman gang dang / /rmongs dang ma rung las byed dang / /gzugs ngan yan lag ma tshang ba/ /bsam pas de rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs phyir ro/ /gnyis pa thabs kyi rgyud la/ skal dman rim 'jug pa dang / skal ldan cig car ba gnyis las/ dang po la spyod pa rim pa can la bslab pa dang / lta ba rim pa can la bslab pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa'i rim pa la bslab pa dang gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ skal dman sems can gdul dka' ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /zhes pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/

dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyabs 'gro gso sbyong / gtan khrims/ dus nam skye nges pa med pa'i sems bskyed dang bzhi yod pa yin la/ gnyis pa lta ba rim pa can la bslab pa la/ yang rtsa rgyud las/ de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ /de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ grub mtha' bzhi las/ dang po bye brag tu smra ba la dman 'bring mchog gsum las/ mchog kha che ba'i lugs ni/ mngon pa mdzod la brten nas shes par bya dgos te/ dag ldan las/ 'di'i gzhung mtha' yas mdo/ gangs can 'di la mdzod kyi rab tu byed pa tsam snang bas der blta bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa mdo sde pa'i lugs ni/ mdzod rang 'grel dang / mngon pa kun las btus gnyis kyi mdo sde pa'i skabs la brten te shes par bya zhing / gsum pa rnal 'byor spyod pa ba'i lugs ni/ byams chos phyi ma gsum dang / thogs med kyi theg bsdus la sogs pa la brten nas shes par bya dgos pa yin la/ bzhi pa dbu ma pa'i lugs ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung la brten te shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa'i rim pa la bslab pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai rdo rje bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyud sde bzhi las/ bya rgyud ni smin byed dang chu dang cod pan gyi dbang thob nas/ bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi la bslabs te mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor sgom par byed/ spyod rgyud ni smin byed chu/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming gi dbang dang lnga thob nas rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa'i rgyud la bslabs te mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor sgom par byed la/ rnal 'byor rgyud ni smin byed chu dbang sogs lnga'i steng du/

phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i dbang thob nas/ de nyid 'dus pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa'i rgyud la bslabs te mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor sgom par byed do/ /rnal 'byor bla med ni smin byed dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob nas pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang / ma rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la sogs pa la bslabs te/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug sgom par byed cing / de dag gi rjes su slar yang gnyis med kyi dpal dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ zab cing rgya che ba'i lam sgom par byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa skal ldan cig car ba ni/ skal dman sems can gdul dka' ba/ /zhes sogs kyi shugs la/ skal ldan sems can 'dul sla ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gso sbyong sbyin sogs mi ltos par/ /dang por kyai rdo rje bstan/ /zhes pa zhig don gyis thob par gsungs pa yin pas/ gang zag skal ba rab dang ldan pa skal ba bzang po can dang po nyid nas dges pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs te dbang bzhi rdzogs par mnos nas grol lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis la sogs pa rnams bsgom pas chog gsungs pa yin la/ de ltar bsgom bya'i grol lam de la yang gsum ste/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs/ gnyis ka'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa'o/ /dang po la lta ba sogs lnga las/ dang po lta ba la gnyis te/ lta ba dang por ston pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rgyu mtshan can gyi lta ba dngos so/ /dang po ni/ grol lam rnams kyi nang nas lta ba dang por ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lta bas rgyud sbyangs te/ de'i rtsis zin pa'i lam thams cad sangs rgya ba'i lam du 'gyur ba dang / lam gzhan las rgya che ba dang / log ltas 'phrog par mi nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la lnga ste/ ye shes de gnas lugs su ngo sprad pa/

ye shes de la gang zag gi bdag tu log par rtog pa dgag pa/ ye shes de'i yul gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa/ gtan la dbab pa de gsung rab thams cad las rtogs byar bstan pa/ gsang sngags kyi thabs kyis rtogs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ye shes de la gnas lugs su ngo sprad pa ni dbang gi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa de'i snang ngo na/ rnam dag ye shes gzugs can te/ sangs rgyas dang / gzhi 'khor ba'i chos tha dad du dbyer med cing ro gcig pas 'khor 'das kun rang bzhin med par mnyam nyid du rtogs pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ phyi nas de nyid yang dag bshad/ /rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang / /'khor ba rnam par rtog pa la/ /khyad par cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /dbang gi ye shes de la yul rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas rang rig pa'i ye shes/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes/ mkha' mnyam gyi ye shes/ rdul bral ye shes/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma gsungs te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rang rig ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ /rang gzhan yang dag rig pa spangs/ /mkha' mnyam rdul bral stong pa nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid mchog /thabs dang shes rab shin tu 'dres/ /chags dang chags bral rnam par 'dres/ /de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid yi ge dam pa ste/ /de nyid 'gro ba'i bdag nyid de/ /de nyid thams cad khyab pa po/ /de nyid sangs rgyas ye shes can/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ye shes de la gang zag gi bdag tu log par rtog pa dgag pa ni/ dbang gi ye shes skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa des ye shes de nyams su myong zhing bla mas ngo sprad pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor pa de'i rjes spyod kyi nyams la bdag gi myong ba 'di ni thams cad kyi myong ba po dang byed pa por 'dug go snyam du rtog na gang zag gi bdag tu log par rtogs pa yin pas/ de dgag pa'i phyir du ye shes de kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bu dang don dam du spros bral du gtan la 'bebs dgos pa yin te/

rtsa rgyud las/ skyes bu sngon rab dbang phyug dang / /bdag dang gso ba sems can dang / /dus dang gang zag nyid dang ni/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'di/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs kyis yang dag gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa ye shes de'i yul gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa ni/ dbang gi ye shes de'i yul ni bden pa gnyis las ma 'das shing / de dag gi rnam gzhag ni/ mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las rgyas par 'byung bas/ de dag shes par byas te rtogs par bya'o/ /bzhi pa gtan la dbab pa'i gnas lugs de gsung rab thams cad las rtogs byar bstan pa ni/ gsung rab rnams las gnas lugs de rtogs par dka' zhing / rtogs na don chen po dang ldan pa yin par gsungs shing / de la ming gi rnam grangs kyang / gzhi dus kyi rdo rje sems dpa' dang / gzhi dus kyi dpal mchog dang po dang / gzhi dus kyi 'jam dpal dang / brjod bya don kyi rdo rje 'chang dang / rang bzhin lhan skyes dang / gzhan yang chos dbyings dang / rgyu bde gshegs snying po la sogs pa du ma'i sgo nas bsngags shing rtogs bya mchog tu bstan pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ zab mo'i rgyud du 'jam dpal dang / /ye shes chen po lhan skyes dang / /rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /kun bzang la sogs bgrangs yas gsungs/ /zhes dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ de nyid rtogs na shin tu don che bar/ /gzigs nas thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du/ /dngos dang brgyud pas rtogs bya'i dam pa zhes/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas bsngags par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa gnas lugs gsang sngags kyi thabs zab mos rtogs par bstan pa la bzhi ste/ rtogs tshul dngos/ lta ba las ye shes khyad par du bstan pa/ ye shes de mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes su bstan pa/ ye shes skye ba'i rten rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/

gnas lugs rang bzhin lhan skyes 'di ni pha rol tu phyin pa ba'i lugs la/ lung dang dpe gtan tshigs la sogs pa thabs gang gis kyang rtogs par mi nus la/ 'o na gang gis rtogs pa yin zhe na/ bla ma mnyes par byas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / dbang gsum pa'i dus dang / thabs mkhas sbyor bas phyag rgya bsten pa dang / bdag gi bsod nams bsags pa las rtogs nus te/ rtsa rgyud las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes dang / ar+ya de was bdag byin rlabs las/ chos kun rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhes/ /sangs rgyas pa kun smra mod kyis/ /bdag byin rlabs las phyir phyogs pas/ /rmi lam sgyu mar rtogs pa med/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa lta ba las ye shes khyad par du bstan pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gsum pa ye shes de dpe'i ye shes su bstan pa ni/ so skye'i gnas skabs su skyes pa'i dbang gi ye shes thams cad mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin te/ dper na byad bzhin blta bar 'dod pa la me long nang gi byad kyi gzugs brnyan mthong ba dang mtshungs pas so/ /bzhi pa ye shes de skye ba'i rten rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul bstan pa ni/ dbang gi ye shes de skye ba'i rten ni rdo rje'i lus nyid yin zhing / 'di nyid grub pa'i tshul ni rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa rnams las mthun par gsungs pas de nyid yin la/ khyad par du rlung rgyu ba'i tshul la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dgongs pa/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dgongs pa/ kyai rdo rje'i dgongs pa dang gsum yod pa'i/ phyi ma kye rdor gyi dgongs pa ni/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab kyi grangs drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa'i dbang gis phyi rol tu dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi 'byung /

dbyug gu re re la rlung sum brgya sum cu so phyed dang brgyad re 'byung bas/ de lta bu drug cu rtsa bzhis nyin zhag re 'da'/ dbyug gu gnyis la chu tshod gcig spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang gis phyi rol tu chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis 'byung / chu tshod re la rlung drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga re rgyu/ chu tshod gnyis la 'pho ba gcig mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi dbang gis phyi rol tu 'pho ba bcu drug 'byung / 'pho ba re la rlung stong dang sum brgya lnga bcu'i tshad/ 'pho ba gnyis la thun phyed pa gcig snying kha'i phyi rol gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbang gis phyi rol tu thun phyed pa brgyad/ thun phyed pa re re la rlung nyis stong bdun brgya pa re rgyu/ de brgyad kyis nyin zhag gcig 'da'/ thun phyed pa gnyis la thun gcig snying kha'i nang skor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi'i grangs kyis phyi rol tu thun bzhi 'byung / thun re la rlung lnga stong bzhi brgya re rgyu/ de bzhis nyin zhag gcig 'dzin te/ gang ltar dngos kyang nyin zhag gcig gi rlung la nyi khri chig stong drug brgya tshang pa yin la/ de lta bu'i rlung lam du byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rlung yid kyi shing rta yin pa'i phyir rlung zin na sems zin/ de las zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin skye zhing / srog rtsol bgrang pas 'das par 'gyur bas na des sgrib pa 'dag par 'gyur la/ gzhan yang chu rlung dkar po rgyu ba'i dus su nad gdon la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi bar bsam pa'am smon pa tsam gyis zhi ba'i las 'grub/ sa rlung ser po rgyu ba'i dus su tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam pa'i smon pa tsam gyis rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa sogs 'phrin las de dang de 'grub pa dang / mthar thug las rlung ye shes kyi rlung du gnas gyur nas sangs rgya ba yin te/ phyag chen thig le las/ rnal 'byor pa yis rlung bsgoms na/

/dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bskyed rim la/ lha'i rnam pa dang / mngon rtogs kyi chings gnyis/ dang po la mchog bsgrub pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor dang / las rgyas pa'i lha'i grangs gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka gsum/ snying po kyai rdo rje/ bdag med ma/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang dang drug gsungs/ rdo rje gur las/ rigs rkyang rgyas pa la/ rigs rkyang pa lnga la 'khor lha mo brgyad brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lha dgu ma lnga/ rigs bsdus rgyas pa la dkyil 'khor gcig gi nang du gtso bo'i rigs lnga so so la 'khor lha mo brgyad brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lha zhe lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig de la dbus kyi gtso bo rigs lnga so so go 'pho ba'i gnad kyis rigs bsdus rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga yang dkyil 'khor gcig gi nang du gtso bo rigs lnga so so la 'khor lha mo bzhi bzhis bskor ba'i lha nyi shu rtsa lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig de la sngar bzhin dbus kyi gtso bo rigs lnga go 'pho ba'i gnad kyis rigs bsdus bsdus pa lha nyer lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ de rnams kyi steng du sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka gsum/ bdag med lha mo bcu gsum ma dang / bco lnga ma ste dngos bstan nyi shu yod de/ rdo rje gur las/ dkyil 'khor re re bsgom pa 'am/ /yang na bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa 'am/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang gur las/ gang tshe dkyil 'khor bsdus pa yis/ /sgor ni lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog de bzhin dril bu nyid/ /'jug pa'i sgo srung dgod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rigs bsdus rgyas bsdus gang yin kyang sgo ba bzhi dgod par bshad pa yin zhing / des na rigs bsdus rgyas pa lha zhe lnga'i steng du sgo ba bzhi bsnan pas lha zhe dgu dang /

bsdus pa la yang de bzhin du sgo ba bzhi bsnan pas lha nyer dgur 'gyur ba yin gsungs so/ /gur nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyi shu po de'i nang nas snga ma bco lnga la bla ma'i man ngag gi sku gsung thugs snying po kyai rdo rje bzhi bzhir gtso bo go 'pho tshul gyi sgo nas drug cu/ bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bsnan pas drug cu rtsa gnyis 'byung ba ni mngon par rtogs pa rin po che ljon shing gi dgongs pa yin la/ gur rgyan las/ de'i steng du rigs bsdus la rgyas bsdus gnyis yod pa ltar/ rigs rkyang la yang rgyas bsdus gnyis su phye nas rigs rkyang bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga la sngar bzhin sku gsung thugs snying po kyai rdo rje dang bzhi bzhir gtso bo go 'pho tshul gyi sgo nas nyi shu 'byung ba bsnan pas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis 'byung bar bshad cing / sam+bu ṭi las/ sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka gsum/ snying po kyai rdo rje/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma lha bcu gsum/ bdag med ma/ rdo rje dbyings/ drag po gdan can nam mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun te lha brgyad/ rdo rje dbyings la gtso bo go 'pho ba'i gnad kyis lngar 'gyur bas bcu gnyis/ rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor drug dang bsdoms pas mchog bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgya tham pa 'byung ba 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi bzhed pa yin la/ 'di yang man ngag lugs dang / 'grel pa lugs gnyis kyi nang nas man ngag lugs kho na yin gsungs so/ /gnyis pa las rgyas pa'i lha'i grangs ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdo rje ma dang / dkar mo dang / chu ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / bdag med ma dang / sa spyod ma dang / mkha' spyod ma'i rnal 'byor mas/ rengs par byed pa la sogs pa brtul zhugs can gyis byed do zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje ma nas rig byed ma'i bar brgyad/ gur las 'byung po 'dul byed nas/ nag po chen po'i bar nyer brgyad/

kha sbyor las/ sgrol ma nas/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bar sum cu ste drug cu rtsa drug yod do/ /gnyis pa mngon rtogs kyi chings ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /rnal 'byor pas ni snyoms 'jug bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /de nas yang ni las rgyal mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa yan sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa nas/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog phra thig sogs bsgom pa las rgyal mchog ste/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi chings ba dang / gur las/ sangs rgyas gnas ni rdzogs pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin dang / /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar bsgrub dang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba sogs/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yan lag drug gi chings ba dang / rtsa rgyud las/ yang ni stong pa byang chub ste/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru dgod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i chings ba ste gsum gsungs la/ dang po ni/ sku gsum lam du bya ba dang / gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba rigs drug dang / gsum pa ni/ sku bzhi lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs yin no/ /sgrub thabs gang la chings gang 'jug ni/ rigs bsdus rnams la chings gsum gang rung dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim la sgra don/ rdzogs rim gnyis kyi spyi 'gro'i chos/ de nyams su len pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ lus ngag yid gsum bde chen gyi ye shes su rdzogs par byin gyis brlabs pas na rdzogs rim zhes bya ba yin no/ /gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i lus sems la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la phyi'i spros pa thams cad nang du spyod pa/ nang byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo/

de mi spong zhing bskyed par bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ phyi'i spros pa thams cad nang du 'du zhing sdom pa yin te/ sde pa bzhi sogs bzhin gyi chos thams cad 'khor lo bzhir sdom/ sku gsum sogs gsum tshan gyi chos thams cad ro rkyang dbu gsum du sdom/ thabs shes gnyis sogs gnyis tshan gyi chos thams cad ro rkyang gnyis su sdom pa'i phyir te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor ma lus dbus gnas su/ /a yi rnam pa sdom pa'i gnas/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /sdom pa'i de nyid rab tu dbye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rtsa ni gnyis gnyis rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes pa nas/ rnal 'byor ma rnams de yi cha/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa ltar sbyang gzhi bcu drug pa tshan pa bdun 'byung ba ni/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu drug pa gnyis lug glang 'khrig pa karka ṭa sogs nas nyi zla 'dzin pa/ thig le 'gog pa/ nam mkha' 'gog pa ste 'pho ba bcu drug rtsa so gnyis las nyis sdebs pa bcu bzhi/ rtsa gtso mo gsum gcig tu byas bdud bral ma dang bcu drug so dang sen mo sogs bskyed pa'i nang gi khams bcu drug yi ge ā li'i rnam pa bcu drug rang bzhin gyi dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs bcu drug rkang pa'i mthe bong nas spyi gtsug kun 'dar gyi bar te gnas bcu drug snga ma bco lnga pa tshan pa bdun thabs spros pa'i rang bzhin gtso che bas sbyong byed lha mos sbyong / phyi ma bcu drug pa tshan pa bdun shes rab stong pa'i rang bzhin gtso che bas sbyong byed he ru kas sbyangs pas thabs shes zung 'jug tu 'gyur te/ bdag med stod 'grel las/ des na rdo rje theg pa'i zab don kun/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa la/ /kho bo'i sems ni mchog tu dang ba yis/ /rdo rje theg la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang yar ngo'i tshes gcig la skyes pa'i rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas dang /

bud med kyi g.yon pa'i mthe bong nas brtsams te tshes bco lnga'i bar la rim gyis 'phos nas bco lnga'i nyin skyes pa'i khams spyi bo'i steng gi ro ma'i steng dang / bud med kyi khams spyi bo'i nang gi rkyang ma'i nang du gnas/ bco lnga'i mtshan mo āḥtsheg drag can gyi rnam pas dbu ma'i steng du thim/ mar ngo la de las go ldog ste bud med kyi rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas dang / skyes pa'i mthe bong g.yon nas brtsams te gnam gang gi bar la gnas so sor rim gyis 'phos nas gnam gang gi nyin bud med kyi spyi bo'i ro ma'i steng dang / skyes pa'i spyi bo'i rkyang ma'i steng du gnas/ de'i mtshan mo āḥtsheg drag gi rnam pas dbu ma'i steng du thim pas de gnyis 'dres te he ru ka'i sa bon hūm̐ gi rnam par grub pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'grib med btung mchog nam mkha' nyid/ /ga pur ci nas nges mi spangs/ /zhes pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam dang ni/ /rang byin rlabs pa'i rim pas kyang / /kun rdzob don dam gzugs can gyi/ /byang chub sems ni rab tu bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ yon tan kun gyi rten du gyur pa'i kun dha byang chub kyi sems mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa de nyams su blang ba la/ rang byin rlabs dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rkyang ma mi bskyod 'bab ma ste/ /zhes sogs ltar rtsa'i rnal 'byor gcig a yi rnam pa sdom pa'i gnas/ /zhes gsungs par/ yi ge bha ga'i rnal 'byor gcig ste gnyis gsungs/ gur las thig le'i rnal 'byor gcig kha sbyor las thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ rlung gi rnal 'byor mang du bshad/ yang rtsa rgyud las gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyi rnal 'byor gcig gur las/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i zhar la gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gcig

sam+bu ṭi las gtum mo'i rnal 'byor nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gur las mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor gcig bshad pa rnams la bslab par bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam la/ dngos kyi phyag rgya dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyis/ dang po la dbang dus dang / lam dus dang / 'bras dus kyi phyag rgya gsum las/ dang po la lang tsho gtso che/ gnyis pa la rigs gtso che/ gsum pa la yon tan gtso che ste/ rim pa bzhin rtsa rgyud las/ bcu gnyis brgyad gnyis lon pa yis/ /zhes sogs dang / gar ma tshos ma rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs dang / mchog thob pa yi bud med gang / /zhes sogs dang / 'dir/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dmigs bcas skye ba'i rten/ /dbang lam 'bras bur lang tsho rigs yon tan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na sgra ji bzhin pa dang / sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa dang / dbang dang 'brel ba dang / yon tan dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyag rgya bzhi las/ dang po la 'jig rten gyi ma dang sring mo sogs brgyad/ bram ze mo sogs brgyad de bcu drug tu yod pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ ma dang sring mo nyid dang yang / /zhes sogs kyis brgyad tshan dang po bstan cing / rtsa rgyud brtag pa dang po las/ gar ma tshos ma rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs kyi dngos shugs las brgyad tshan gnyis pa bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni 'jig rten gyi ma sogs sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa bram ze mo sogs brgyad la ma sogs brgyad kyi tha snyad gsungs pa yin te/ kha sbyor las/ ma ni skye gnyis de bzhin gshegs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni phyag rgya gcig nyid la yon tan gyi ldog cha brgyad tshang ba ni ma sogs brgyad du 'gyur ba yin te/ phyag rgya gcig nyid rang gi gsang dbang gi rten du gyur pa la ma dang / sher dbang gi rten du gyur pa la sring mo sogs kyi tha snyad byed pa'i phyir ro/

/bzhi pa ni phyag rgya gcig nyid la yon tan gyi ldog cha bcu drug tshang ba ni ma sogs bcu drug tu 'gyur te/ rtsa rgyud las/ gang phyir skye 'gro bskyed pa yi/ /shes rab ma zhes brjod par bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni/ rlung la brtan pa ma thob pa dang / thob kyang bslab pas bcings pa dang / bstan pa la smod pa'i nyes pa 'gog pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya yid kyis bsams nas snyoms 'jug gi bde ba bsgom pa ste/ sam+bu ṭi las bshad do/ /bsten thabs 'du shes gsum ldan sogs ni/ bsten thabs 'du shes gsum ldan dbab zlog gnyis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa spyod pa ni/ drod thob nas spyod pa bya zhing / drod kyi ngo bo ni rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa las byung ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi nus mthu khyad par can zhig yin la/ de la drod chung 'bring che gsum las/ dang po ni/ mnyam bzhag tu 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa snyam byed pa sogs/ drod chung ngu thob nas kun 'dar gsang nas spyod/ tshar bcad rjes bzung gang rung nus pa drod 'bring thob nas kun 'dar 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod/ kun 'dar mngon spyod kyi drod chen po ma thob na lha gnad la bor ba zhes bya ba drag shul gyi sgrub pa zla ba bco brgyad bya/ rnam shes dang ye shes cha mnyam pas tshar bcad dang rjes bzung gnyis ka nus pa drod chen po thob nas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bya/ 'grub sla ba kha cig la kun bzang gi spyod pa zla ba gcig gis sa brgyad pa thob nas/ nyer rgyu'i spyod pa zhag bdun gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa thob pa'ang yod/ yang kha cig gis/ kun bzang gi spyod pa zla ba du ma dang lo la sogs pas sa bcu gnyis pa thob nas nye rgyu'i spyod pa zhag gcig gis 'bras bu mchog rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob pa'ang yod de/ rdo rje gur las/

nyi ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyi ma gnyis kyi cho ga dang / /nyi ma gsum gyi sbyor ba dang / /zhes pa nas/ sbyor ba la ni yang dag brtsams/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i dus su ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa nye rgyu ni/ thabs sgrub pa pos rang byin rlabs kyi zhu bde gnyis/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i zhu ba gnyis te bzhi/ yum la'ang de ltar bzhi ste brgyad dam/ yang na yum gyis rang byin rlabs ma bsgoms kyang chog pas/ drug gi bdag nyid de dbang gi gnas mchog gi ze bar 'dzoms pas thig le zla ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ rak+ta nyi ma mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rlung sems ma 'dres pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ thams cad ro gcig pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de nas rlung 'dren pa zhes bya ba thabs la mkhas pas g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas drangs te thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyud so sor dag pa byas nas spyi gtsug tu thim pas gtsug tor mchog 'grub/ skad cig de la chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo lus zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku dang / sems rtog med ye shes su gnas gyur nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob ste 'khor ba ji srid par 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs bskul ba bzlas nas/ 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byed pa gtor ma/ dngos grub myur du 'grub pa sbyin sreg byin gyis brlabs pas kyang dngos grub 'grub pa rab gnas/ gdul bya dman pa dngos grub sna tshogs la mos pa rjes su 'dzin pa'i spyir las kyi tshogs rab 'byams dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ gnas skabs rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i man ngag dag dang dgos pa 'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni gtor ma dus dang /

zhes pa nas/ bcu drug go zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ sbyin sreg thab dang bud shing sbar ba me/ /zhes pa nas/ drug gsum bco brgyad do/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ rab gnas rten dang slob dpon dus dang gnas/ /zhes pa nas/ mkha' spyod rig 'dzin 'khor los bsgyur rnams 'grub/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ lnga pa ni/ zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i las sna tshogs pas bstan pa dang sems can la phan gdags par bya ba nyid yin no/ /bcu gcig pa gnyis ka'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing / /zhes sogs dang / ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /zhes sogs ltar/ las dang po pa'i dam tshig dang / phyag rgya bcings pa rnams spangs shing / /zhes sogs ltar/ brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig dang / rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing / /zhes sogs ltar brtan pa cung zad thob pa'i dam tshig rnams rang gi rgyud tshod dang sbyar te rim pas bslab par bya ba yin la/ dam tshig de dag bsdu na/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig gnyis sam sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum du 'du ste/ sam+bu ṭi las/ bud med dang ni skyes pa'i lus/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa des 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis/ dang po la gnas kyi sa dang nye ba'i gnas kyi sa la sogs pa rgyu'i sgo nas ming btags pa slob lam sa bcu gnyis su yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing nyid dang / /tshan+dho nye ba'i tshan+dho dang / /de bzhin 'du ba nye 'du dang / /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod dang / /'thung spyod nye ba'i 'thung spyod nyid/ /'di rnams sa ni bcu gnyis te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar rgyu'i sgo nas ming btags she na/ spyi bo pu li ra ma la ya'am/ brtag gnyis ltar na/

ko la gi ri ste/ 'di la ko la gi ri zhes pa gang ba'i ri dang / pu la ra ma la ya zhes pa rgyas pa'i ri yin pas de gnyis gcig pa yin gsungs so/ /spyi gtsug dza lan+dha ra/ rna ba g.yas pa o ḍi ya na/ ltag pa arbu ta ste gnas kyis bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa las sa dang po'i rtogs pa skye la/ snga ma'i rten 'brel gyi phyi'i yul chen bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing / rtogs pa'i khyad par chos dbyings kun 'gro'i tshul gyis mthong / yon tan gyi khyad par brgya phrag bcu gnyis sam bcu gsum dus gcig la thob/ de bzhin du rna ba g.yon pa go ta wa ri'am/ ba'i mchog sbyin/ mig gnyis de wi ko ṭa/ smin phrag rasmi shwa ra/ phrag pa ma la wa ste nye ba'i gnas kyis bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa las sa gnyis pa'i rtogs pa skye/ snga ma'i rten 'brel gyis phyi rol gyi yul chen bzhi'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du/ rtogs pa'i khyad par snga ma las ches gsal bar gyur pa ni sa 'og ma kun la bsgre/ yon tan gyi khyad par sngar gyi de stong 'gyur thob/ mchan khung ka ma ru pa dang nu ma gnyis o ṭe ste zhing gis bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen gnyis kyi rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi'i yul chen gnyis kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing sa gsum pa'i rtogs pa skye/ yon tan gyi khyad par sngar gyi de 'bum 'gyur thob/ lte ba tri sha ku ni/ sna rtse ko sa la ste nye zhing gis bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen gnyis kyi rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel las phyi'i yul chen gnyis kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing sa bzhi pa'i rtogs pa skye/ yon tan gyi khyad par snga ma de bye ba phrag brgya thob/ kha ka liṅka dang mgrin pa lam+pa ka ste/ tshon+dhos bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen gnyis kyi rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi'i yul chen gnyis gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing sa lnga pa'i rtogs pa skye/

yon tan gyi khyad par snga ma de bye ba phrag stong thob/ snying kañtsi dang 'doms hi ma la ya ste nye ba'i tshan+dhos bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen gnyis kyi rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel las phyi'i yul chen gnyis kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing sa drug pa'i rtogs pa skye/ yon tan gyi khyad par snga ma de bye ba phrag 'bum thob/ mtshan ma pre ta pu ri/ bshang lam gṛ ha de wa ste 'du bas bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen gnyis kyi rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi'i yul chen gnyis kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing sa bdun pa'i rtogs pa skye/ yon tan gyi khyad par snga ma de bye ba phrag khrig 'bum thob/ brla gnyis sau raṣ+ṭa/ byin pa gnyis gser gling ste nye ba'i 'du bas bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen gnyis kyi rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi'i yul chen gnyis kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing sa brgyad pa'i rtogs pa skye/ yon tan gyi khyad par 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum gyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa thob/ sor mo bcu drug na ga ra dang / bol gong sin+dhu ra ste dur khrod kyis bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen gnyis kyi rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi'i yul chen gnyis kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du sa dgu pa'i rtog pa skye/ yon tan gyi khyad par 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa thob/ mthe bong bzhi ma ru/ pus mo gnyis ku lu ta ste nye ba'i dur khrod kyis bsdus pa'i nang gi yul chen gnyis kyi rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi'i yul chen gnyis kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing sa bcu pa'i rtogs pa skye/ yon tan gyi khyad par sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams 'byams klas kyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa thob/

yang bdag med bstod pa las/ 'di bzhi snying gi 'dab brgyad lte ba yi/ /mtshams gnas rlung dang bdud rtsi lnga 'dres 'bab/ /'di rnams dbu mar thim pas 'thung gcod de/ /dpe med ye shes bcu gcig par phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i 'dab ma brgyad phyi skor dang lte ba nang skor yin la/ nang skor la 'dab ma bzhi las med kyang mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa ser skya re yod par bshad pas de bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi rol gyi 'thung gcod kyis bsdus pa'i las kyi brang ha ri ke la/ lañtsha'i rgya mtsho'i nang skyes bin+dha ste yul chen bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing sa bcu gcig pa'i rtogs pa skye/ yon tan gyi khyad par snga ma des dpe bya bar mi nus pa'i yon tan thob/ yang bdag med bstod pa las/ dbus gnas g.yas g.yon rgyab kyi cha la zhugs/ /kun dha ro rkyang bdud dral cha dang bcas/ /khu khrag dri chen dri chu mi rtog skyed/ /'phags pa'i lam gsum byang chub la phyag 'tshal/ /gnas bzhi dbu mar stong las bcu gnyis pa/ /nye ba'i 'thung gcod ye shes chen po ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus kyi dbus na gnas pa'i dbu ma g.yas g.yon gyi ro rkyang gnyis/ de dag gi rgyab na gnas pa'i bdud dral ma ste bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis nye ba'i 'thung gcod kyis bsdus pa'i gzhon nu ma'i grong khyer/ rab song dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ skyed tshal ra ba'i rdzing bu'i 'gram ste phyi'i yul chen bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing sa bcu gnyis pa'i rtogs pa skye/ yon tan gyi khyad par snga ma de las kyang gya nom pa'i yon tan thob pa yin no gsungs/ gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ bdag med bstod pa las/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga bdud dral cha dang bcas/ /snying gi dbus gnas gtsug tor mchog tu thim/ /'phags pa'i lam lnga drug pa'i cha yi dngos/

/rdo rje 'dzin sa bcu gsum par phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang sam+bu ṭi las/ lus can snying gi dbus su ni/ /rtsa rnams lnga ni yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa ltar/ rtsa thams cad kyi nus pa 'dus pa snying gi dbus su dbu ma nyid la brten pa'i sbas pa'i rtsa lnga/ de dag kyang yi ge thams cad kyi nus pa 'dus pa dbus su hūm̐ dang / phyogs bzhir bh+rum̐ am̐ dz+riṃ kham̐ gi rnam par gnas la/ de dag gi nang na rlung sems thams cad kyi nus pa 'dus pa'i rlung sems gnas pa rnams gtsug tor mchog gi dbu mar thim pa las sa bcu gsum pa'i rtogs pa skye la/ sbas pa'i rtsa lngas mtshon pa'i phyi'i yul chen lhag ma lnga ni phyi ltar na rdo rje gdan/ nang ltar na 'og min stug po bkod pa/ nges pa'i don du na sgrub pa po rang nyid gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas dang de'i phyogs bzhi la bya dgos te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor che mchog he ru ka /yul phyogs gang du gnas gyur pa/ /yul ngan kla klo yin na yang / /yul de yongs su brtag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sa bcu gsum pa thob pa'i snga ltas su nye rgyu'i skabs bshad pa'i lha mo bstan ma dga' mgu yid rangs te sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa dang / bdud kyi gnas su gnam rdo lhung ba dang / cha lang lta bu'i sgra grags pas bdud kyi klad pa 'gems pa dang / lha klu gnod sbyin dri za la sogs pas mchod pa'i bkod pa gzhal du med pas mchod pa byed par kha sbyor las bshad pa'i don 'dir 'grel pa ni/ nye rgyu la brten 'bras bu'i ngo mtshar ltas/ /sa chen g.yo dang tshar bcad rjes bzung dang / /sku dang ye shes mngon du gyur sogs 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob pa na rdo rje sems dpa' sogs sku bzhi dang ye shes lnga dang kha sbyor yan lag bdun sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyur zhing /

yon tan de dag grub mtha' so so'i 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang bcas pa ni/ de yi ngo bo rnam grol chos sku dang / /zhes pa nas/ sku gsung thugs dang snying po rdo rje dang / /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de yang 'chad byed mngon rtogs kyi sgo nas char phye na/ mthar thug gnas yongs gyur dang ye shes sku/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das dang gnyis su med/ /mdzad pa rgyun mi chad dang rnam lnga'o/ /zhes pa ltar lnga las/ dang po gnas gyur pa ni/ gzugs sogs phung po gnas gyur rigs lnga dang / /zhes pa nas/ lus gnas gyur pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi sku ni/ sangs rgyas la sku med pa ma yin zhing / sku de bem po yang ma yin zhing / rdo rje gur las/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ci lags/ bka' stsal pa/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni ljon shing mdzes rgyan 'dir/ brnyes nas yon tan 'phrin las brtan gyur phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ 'khor ba'i mtha' kun mnan phyir spros las grol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas/ snying rje chen pos zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud phyi ma las/ chags dang 'jig pa dag gis kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gnon mi 'gyur/ /gang phyir thabs ni 'byung ba nyid/ /'jig pa shes rab srid mthar byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa gnyis su med pa ni/ srid zhi mnyam nyid rtogs pa de'ang rtogs bya rtogs byed gnyis su med par rtogs pa yin te/ sam+bu ṭi las/ rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa ni gang du yang mi 'gro/ gang du yang mi gnas zhes sogs chos sku'i mtshan nyid nyi shu rtsa drug gis bsdus nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ 'dir/ de ltar srid zhi mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ mkha' mnyam rnam rtog las grol rtog med do/

/zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ lnga pa ni chos sku mdzad pa'i rgyu yin zhing / longs spyod rdzogs skus sa bcu pa'i byang sems kyi don mdzad/ sprul pa mchog gis grub pa'i sa la gnas pa yan chad kyi don mdzad/ sprul pa 'bring gis rigs can gsum gyi don mdzad/ sprul pa tha mas ri bong dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / glang po che la sogs pa gang la gang 'dul gyi gzugs su bstan nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /zhes pa nas/ ri bong stag dang seng ge dang / /glang po rnams kyi rigs su yang / /snying rjes phan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /phyag rgya grub pa skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na snying rjes sems can gyi don nam yang mi gtong bas mdzad pa po la skyo dub mi mnga'/ mdzad yul gyi sems can la mu mtha' med pa'i phyir na 'khor ba ji srid par mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa yin no/ /zhes pa ni/ de ltar snying rjes 'khor ba mi gtong phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ rtag par 'byung ba rgyal ba'i phrin las so/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa yin no/ /de dag ni tshul bzhi pa rgyud kyi lam rim mngon par rtogs pa'i rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa ste de rnams kyi sgo nas rgyud kyi sngon 'gro tshul bzhi zhes bya ba bstan zin nas// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa gzhung gi 'bru gnyer ba'i sgo nas rgyud dngos bshad pa la gnyis te/ rgyud kyi tshig don mtha' dag zhib tu bshad pa'i sgo nas rgyud ma lus pa bshad pa dang / rgyud kyi khog phug pa'i sgo nas gzhung don ma lus pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skal bzang blo gros can rnams kyis rje sa chen gyi dka' 'grel/ slob dpon rin po che'i rnam bshad nyi 'od/ rje btsun gyi rnam bshad dag ldan rnams la brten nas rtogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la rtsa rgyud bshad pa/
